takeaways: Tech giants are pivoting toward nuclear energy and vertical chip integration to secure AI infrastructure, even as global regulatory backlash and environmental concerns stall data center expansion.

The U.S. has centralized AI oversight under a new 'Super Intelligence Force,' while China’s rapid technological gains and aggressive semiconductor stockpiling intensify global competitive and trade pressures.
Bond markets are signaling fiscal anxiety as 'bond vigilantes' demand higher premiums, complicating the global economic outlook amid stubborn inflation and cooling labor markets.
day_verdict: Today is a read-carefully day due to the major geopolitical shift of the new US 'Super Intelligence Force' and significant structural headwinds in the data center and semiconductor sectors.

items.title: US Tech Giants Secure Nuclear Power via Long-Term Deals
bullets: Major technology firms are increasingly securing long-term nuclear power contracts to meet the massive, consistent energy demands required by expanding AI data center infrastructure.
